reuse.why: The new setMonthAvg re-inlines the body of the existing exported setNMonthAvg (getCategoryAverage + income sign flip + setBudget) instead of calling it, and the saved-template SQL test is written afresh rather than shared with the identical source='ui' checks already in statements.ts.

duplication.why: The saved-template condition appears twice in actions.ts (the visibleUntemplatedCategory WHERE fragment and the CASE in getBudgetData), the hidden/group-hidden rule is decided in SQL for setZero/averages but in JS for copyPreviousMonth, and setMonthAvg copies setNMonthAvg.

placement.why: All changes stay in server/budget/actions.ts next to the month-wide actions and their query helpers, which is where this tree keeps that logic.

scope.why: Besides the exclusion rule it restructures set3/6/12MonthAvg into a new setMonthAvg and swaps set6/12's per-category setNMonthAvg calls for inlined logic, an unrequested refactor of the averaging path.

maintainability.why: The exclusion rule is spread over a SQL WHERE string, a SQL CASE column and a JS condition, so a future change to which categories month-wide actions skip must be made in several shapes.

bypasses_abstraction.where: setMonthAvg in server/budget/actions.ts reimplements setNMonthAvg instead of calling it; copyPreviousMonth applies the hidden/template rule in JS instead of the new getVisibleUntemplatedCategories selection.

disguised_duplication.where: setMonthAvg is setNMonthAvg's body reshaped into a loop (category is_income taken from the row instead of a query); the saved-template predicate is restated as a WHERE fragment and as a CASE expression in getBudgetData.

one_place.where: Hidden/group-hidden/saved-template exclusion lives in visibleUntemplatedCategory (setZero, set3/6/12MonthAvg via getVisibleUntemplatedCategories) and separately in getBudgetData's CASE plus copyPreviousMonth's JS if-condition.
